issue: मेरी बिरद संभारो — बिरद is usually the Lord’s own renown, his pledge to save the fallen (अपनी बिरद संभारो, ‘keep up your name’); both witnesses print मेरी.
our reading: as printed: uphold my honour (मेरी मर्यादा सँभालिये)
alternatives: keep up your own renown (if मेरी stands for the Lord’s pledge to me)

issue: पूर्णेन्दु शिव साखि — the signature line: the poet’s name, with Śiva as witness; no verb of saying is printed.
our reading: Pūrṇendu says it with Śiva as his witness
alternatives: शिव as ‘auspicious’ (Pūrṇendu bears witness to the blessing)
